deadline.value: The early fall deadline is February 15, 2027; later deadlines are April 15 and July 15.
deadline.quote: February 15 (early) April 15 (regular) and July 15 (late) for fall semester

gre_subject.value: The physics GRE subject test is recommended.
gre_subject.quote: The physics subject exam is also recommended

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; you meet a specialization adviser after you enter.
supervisor.quote: Upon entering the program the student must consult with the specialization adviser

funding.value: Beyond university assistantships, participating hospitals may support students; no guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: In addition to available Oakland University graduate assistantships, hospitals participating in this program may provide support for qualified students

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in physics, chemistry, mathematics, biology or engineering is enough to be considered.
entry_route.quote: Students will be considered for admission if they hold a baccalaureate degree in physics, chemistry, mathematics, biology, engineering, or other disciplines related to medical physics

gre_general.value: Official GRE results are required, but the general GRE is waived for a recent US or Canadian MS in physics, medical physics, biology or chemistry.
gre_general.quote: Official results of the Graduate Record Examination (GRE)

also.quote: will waive the general GRE for students with an MS degree
